propositions: Project code-review criteria are excluded from eval/calibration admission because _code_review_prompt_id accepts only static built-in ids and calibrate_criterion maps only through the plan-review namespace

_code_review_prompt_id must accept an optional repo_root parameter and admit both built-in ids and active project criteria resolved from code_review.registry.effective_criteria when repo_root is provided

calibrate_criterion must select the code-review arm when repo_root is not None and the criterion is active, resolving via criterion_prompt_id with gate_key='code_review', while retaining unchanged plan-review behavior otherwise
Dispatch at eval_solver.py:279 must pass repo_root to _code_review_prompt_id before invoking _run_code_review_case
Active project code-review criteria with missing eval specs must raise located EvalError containing the logical criterion_id
Backward compatibility requires _code_review_prompt_id to admit built-in ids without repo_root and plan-review criteria to follow unchanged paths even when repo_root is supplied
